asked.item: LinkedIn comments and DMs in Inbox
TikTok comments and DMs in Inbox

verdict.reason: Sentences state Inbox covers only Instagram and Facebook, and that LinkedIn and TikTok comments/DMs are not supported.

steps.text: No, LinkedIn comments and direct messages are not supported in Inbox.
TikTok comments are not supported either, and Inbox direct messages cover Instagram and Facebook only.
Use each other platform's own inbox for those conversations.
